liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Crazy Fingers** (1 review): Review calls this the first Crazy Fingers ever, describing it as dreamlike and serene [16]
- **Beat It On Down The Line** (1 review): The jam in Beat It On Down The Line and Big River are strong [16]
- **Help On The Way** (1 review): First live performance of Help On The Way, Slipknot, and Franklin's Tower [26]

## The recordings

- **gd1975-06-17.fob.menke.motb.97077.flac16** (recommended): source not stated; 16 songs; 114 min; rated 4.6/5 by 5 [1]
- **gd1975-06-17.143102.SonyECM-280.bertrando.dalton.sirmick.miller.fixed.flac1644**: source not stated; 16 songs; 109 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [2]
- **gd1975-06-17.mtx.tobin.96148.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 15 songs; 112 min; rated 5/5 by 7 [5]
- **gd1975-06-17.sbd.GEMS.96125.flac16**: soundboard; 15 songs; 112 min; rated 4.25/5 by 8 [7]
- **gd75-06-17.bertrando.unknown.233.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 15 songs; 102 min; rated 4.34/5 by 35 [9]. Said about its sound: Recording captures audience excitement and ambience that a soundboard simply cannot; For a 1975 audience recording, the sound quality is considered pretty good [18][19]
- **gd75-06-17.sbd.partial.backus.20084.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 5 songs; 35 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [14]. Said about its sound: Sound is lacking but could be a lot worse; historical value makes it worth listening [26]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Tuning/ Bill Graham [1]
- Only time in 1975 the Dead played Winterland, while on hiatus from group performances [23]
- Poster indicated Jerry Garcia and friends, as the Dead were on indefinite hiatus [25]
- Other artists included Kingfish, Keith and Donna, and The Mirrors [2]
- Audience recorded from Winterland floor, about 30-35 feet back, left of dead center [7]
- Musically not as good as Golden Gate Park, though the show is solid [21]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1975-06-17.fob.menke.motb.97077.flac16**: taped by Bob Menke & Louis Falanga; transferred by Transfer by Bob Menke; Mastering By: Derek McCabe; source: 1 x ECM250, 1 x ECM 270 => Sony TC-152SD >> MAC [1]
- **gd1975-06-17.143102.SonyECM-280.bertrando.dalton.sirmick.miller.fixed.flac1644**: taped by Rob Bertrando; transferred by Tim Dalton and Charlie Miller and Sirmick; source: Sony ECM-280's > Sony TC-152SD > Cass master > reel > dat (44.1) - Recorded by Rob Bertrando from the floor, about 30-35' back, just to the left of dead… [2]. Also: Tape flip after Me And My Uncle crossfaded; first 27 seconds of intro patched [2]
- **gd1975-06-17.mtx.tobin.96148.flac16**: transferred by Kevin Tobin; source: Matrix mix (SBD/AUD) [5]. Also: Source: MSR at 7 1/2 ips transferred to Maxell UDXL II reel at 3 3/4 ips [5]
- **gd1975-06-17.sbd.GEMS.96125.flac16**: transferred by Jamie Waddell and Kevin Tobin; source: MSR@ 7 1/2 ips>R@ 3 3/4 ips > CD [7]. Also: Sony ECM-280 mics to Sony TC-152 SD cassette, played back on Nak Dragon to DAT [7]
- **gd75-06-17.bertrando.unknown.233.sbeok.shnf**: taped by Rob Bertrando; source: Audience [9]. Also: Recorded by Rob Bertrando using Sony ECM-280 mics and Sony TC-152 SD cassette; Transfer chain: CM to DAT to CD to EAC to SHN [9]
- **gd75-06-17.sbd.partial.backus.20084.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by David Backus; source: Soundboard [14]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Winterland Arena - June 17, 1975](https://www.dead.net/show/june-17-1975) [29]
